snippet_primary: "Remember that we are a company based in the USA and that all payments that are made via the website are charged in USD. That said, you would need to bear in mind the exchange rate in addition to the commission that your bank or payment processor would take. This information is included on the website and is shown before the payment confirmation, both in your cart and during the purchase process."
subject_exact: Domestika's USD-only charge policy and disclaimer of buyer-side exchange-rate/bank-commission exposure
local_qualifiers: exchange rate and bank/processor commission shown before payment confirmation
